message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: mother abandons newborn baby in a ditch near a pond; baby later taken by others. This is abandonment of a minor. Under Chinese law, "遗弃罪" (abandonment) applies. Specifically, "遗弃罪" under Article 261 of Criminal Law: abandoning a minor under 14 years old, or a person unable to take care of themselves, causing death or serious injury, etc. Even if no death, abandonment of a minor is punishable. So the crime is "遗弃罪". Possibly also "危害公共安全罪"? No. The act is abandonment of a child. So answer: [罪名]遗弃罪<eoa>.
